A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same SV-GS work, and all 11 pages are readable, including equations, figures, tables and references. Neither supplied PDF contains an appendix or embedded supplement; both mention supplementary material that is outside the supplied files.

before.justification: v1 reports original reconstruction experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets, with quantitative comparisons in Tables 1–3 and component ablations in Table 4.

after.justification: v2 retains the original reconstruction experiments, qualitative demonstrations and quantitative results in Tables 1–4.

M1.justification: Sections 3 and 4.3 retain the same skeleton-driven deformation, learnable skinning weights, detail deformation, training losses, interpolation procedure and diffusion-based initialization.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate D-NeRF, DG-Mesh, ZJU-MoCap and the DAVIS camel scene. The sparse-observation tasks and scenarios with or without multi-view initialization are unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged: Table 1 includes 4DGS, SK-GS, RigGS and skeleton-initialized RigGS; Table 2 includes the first three; Table 3 includes AP-NeRF and RigGS. The qualitative comparisons also retain the same methods.

E3.justification: The scene selections, temporal subsampling, initialization controls and SSIM/PSNR/LPIPS metrics are unchanged. Both retain the 0.05/0.1 synthetic sampling intervals, 10×/5× ZJU-MoCap frame reductions and 40,000-step deformation optimization.

E4.justification: Section 4.4, Table 4 and Figure 10 retain the same ablations of motion regularization, skinning correction and detail deformation. The sparsity comparisons and diffusion-initialization case studies are also unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions use the same average and worst-case result aggregation. Neither reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests.

E6.justification: All entries in Tables 1–4 and the qualitative result images match. For example, SV-GS retains D-NeRF PSNR 27.75 and ZJU-MoCap PSNR 28.13/28.83 for the 10×/5× settings. No findings or result entries are added or removed.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(12), mathematical definitions and skeleton assumptions are unchanged. Visual inspection confirms that differences in extracted equation text do not represent mathematical revisions.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims: sparse articulated reconstruction, smooth interpolation, diffusion-assisted initialization, up to 34% PSNR improvement on synthetic data and comparable real-world performance with fewer frames.

C2.justification: The explanations of baseline failures and component effects are retained. Both versions discuss SDS texture oversaturation, initialization failures under severe self-occlusion or uncommon viewpoints, and interpolation difficulties with complex motion.

D1.justification: Section 4.1 retains the RTX 4080 hardware, PyTorch/Adam implementation, loss weights, optimization budget and skeleton initialization details. No technical instructions or code/data access information are added or revised.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion and research positioning are unchanged. All 70 references match after accounting for page reflow; no cited works are added or removed.

P1.justification: v2 adds both authors' email addresses and a funding acknowledgment before the references. The scientific prose, terminology and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The author block gains email lines, the acknowledgment reflows the references, and page 8 has small typography and spacing changes. All ten figures and four tables retain their content and organization; pages 2–7 render identically.

improvement.justification: v2 adds author contact information and funding attribution, with minor formatting changes. The methods, evidence, explanations and limitations remain unchanged, and the layout changes do not materially affect readability. These administrative additions produce no meaningful overall quality difference.
